name: SCUMMVMSA
description: Standalone ScummVM 2026.3.0 for NextUI. Full ScummVM GUI and options, per-game keymaps, virtual keyboard, label-correct controls with a d-pad mouse on stickless devices. Power button sleep/shutdown via minui-power-control.
author: Helaas

changelog.v1.0.0: Initial release. Standalone ScummVM 2026.3.0 (pinned to fed42f2) built once for tg5040, tg5050, my355 and h700, using each firmware's SDL2. Handheld controls: A/B/X/Y follow the printed labels, Menu opens the ScummVM menu, Start the game menu, and the d-pad moves the mouse on devices without sticks. minui-power-control 3.0.0 provides power button deep sleep and shutdown on tg5040, tg5050 and my355.
